name: MD5 Hash Generator
summary: Compute the MD5 hash of any text locally — great for checksums and cache keys.
description: Generate an MD5 digest for any UTF-8 text. MD5 is fast and handy for non-security checksums and cache keys, but is not collision-resistant. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Is MD5 secure?
faqs.answer: No. MD5 is broken for security purposes. Use it only for checksums, deduplication and cache keys — never for passwords or signatures.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The MD5 computation runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Why use MD5 at all?
faqs.answer: It is fast and produces a short 32-character digest, which is convenient for non-security fingerprints.
